dossier_meta.paper: Independence number in triangle-free graphs avoiding a minor
dossier_meta.statement_text: For all $s \geq 4$, a similar bound must hold: $MR_t(s, k) \leq t^{1-\varepsilon}k$ for sufficiently large $t$, and here $\varepsilon$ cannot be larger than $1/s$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper's main result (Theorem 1) establishes $MR_t(3,k) \leq t^{1-\varepsilon}k$ for any $0 < \varepsilon < 1/26$ and all sufficiently large $t$; Erdős's construction (Theorem 2) shows $\varepsilon \leq 1/3$ is essentially tight for $s=3$. The authors conjecture in Section 4 that an analogous upper bound holds for $K_s$-free graphs with $s \geq 4$, with tightness at $\varepsilon = 1/s$.
